mapper.select: select c.id as categoryId, c.type, c.name as categoryName, c.sort, d.id, d.name, d.price, d.image, d.description, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dish_flavor df WHERE df.dish_id = d.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_flavor from category c join dish d on c.id = d.category_id where c.status = 1 and d.status = 1 union all select c.id as categoryId, c.type, c.name as categoryName, c.sort, s.id, s.name, s.price, s.image, s.description, 0 AS has_flavor from category c join setmeal s on c.id = s.category_id where c.status = 1 and s.status = 1 order by sort, categoryId, id
mapper.insert: insert into category (type, name, sort, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{type}, #{name}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update:
update category
type = #{type},
name = #{name},
sort = #{sort},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime},
update_user = #{updateUser}
where id = #{id}
